saga: Y1 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y1 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y1 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Wyrmditch. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y2 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”

Y5 The host marches on Wyrmditch — 14 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y5 The host falls upon Wyrmditch — and the war-band gathered at the tents turns to meet them!
Y5 The assault on Wyrmditch is REPULSED — 11 of 14 lost. The warlord is emboldened.
Y5 The war-camp stirs — Wyrmditch may march soon.

Y6 A warlord has claimed Wyrmditch: Warlord Steinar Wolfjaw. His banner rises over the tents.
Y6 A rider from Warlord Steinar Wolfjaw: "1299 gold — or I come and take it."
Y6 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “Danegeld. Pay, and the warlord leaves — and returns hungrier. Refuse, and he comes now. There is no third rider.”
Y6 Steward Sibyl the Steady: “Warlord Steinar Wolfjaw has claimed the nest. His raids will march from there — you can watch that road now.”
Y6 You send the rider back with empty hands. Warlord Steinar Wolfjaw marches.
Y6 The host falls upon Wyrmditch! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y6 The camp is stripped bare — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods.
Y6 One slips through the reeds — Ebba, a midwife. Remember the name: Ebba.
Y6 Wyrmditch is no more. 8 souls. The Chronicle will keep their names even if you will not.
Y6 14 of your soldiers come home marked by the burning. Nothing frightens them now — and they will never lay down the sword.
Y7 The host returns from the ashes of Wyrmditch. No songs are sung.
Y7 Warlord Steinar Wolfjaw returns to what was Wyrmditch. Ashes. Silence. Something in him breaks.
